linea_ayuda: Pick a class to see its messages.
sin_mensajes_clase: This class has no messages yet.
vacio_texto: Want to be the first? Tell us in a few lines what you take away from the course.
demo_aviso: Sample view: messages tagged “Sample” are placeholders.
como_titulo: How do I leave my message?
como_intro: Messages are added with a Pull Request on GitHub. Simoneth reviews it, and once she merges it, your message shows up on the wall.
paso_1: Pick your course, build your file with this form and copy it.
paso_2: On GitHub, create the new file in your course folder with the name we give you and paste the content.
paso_3: Open the Pull Request and tick the consent box.
form_ayuda: This form does not send anything: it only builds the text for your Pull Request.
form_consentimiento: I agree that my display name and my message may be published on this wall and on the AcademiaQA and Simoneth Gomez websites.
privacidad_corta: Only your display name, your role or country (if you add it) and your message are published.
privacidad_texto: Only what you write is published: your display name, your role or country if you add it, and your message. We never ask for an email, phone number or any other contact detail, and validation rejects messages that include them. Your GitHub username is visible in the Pull Request. To have your message removed, open a Pull Request that deletes it or reach out to Simoneth on social media.
